# hundreds of passes. 8 of 10 addresses named by ACTION p765-D resolve to a LIVE successor.
# METHOD: 422 on repo:<addr> -> resolve by name search -> PROVE the redirect by fetching one real
# payload path at both addresses and comparing bytes. Identical bytes = same object = redirect proven.
# The 404 sentinel (sha256_12 d5558cd419c8, raw's "404: Not Found" body) is excluded on both sides;
# comparing two 404 bodies produced a false "identical" in this pass's first attempt and was corrected.
